path = "/health"
port = "app.http"
use = "ato.contract.http@1"

[contract.require.expect]
body_digest = "sha256:e1facfb37c9f39db4aedb1c196f56a0b5c0f90b0fc2318977b1036d9e0aaf999"
status = 200

[[derive.step]]
argv = ["/opt/ato/toolchains/python/3.12.7/bin/python3", "-B", "/app/serve.py"]
cwd = "."
id = "app"
op = "serve"
use = "ato.process@1"

[[input]]
id = "workspace"
path = "."
use = "ato.workspace@1"

[[port]]
from = "app"
guest_port = 8000
id = "app.http"
use = "ato.http@1"

[[runtime]]
name = "python"
version = "3.12.7"
